meta.homeTitle: MAKERS | Private-label clothing production in Algeria
meta.homeDesc: Request a sample for your clothing brand. MAKERS assigns each product to a specialist workshop in Algeria and stays your single point of contact.

bar.text: Private label in Algeria: start with a sample

hero.text: Start with a sample, with no production commitment. MAKERS assigns each product to a specialist workshop and stays your single point of contact, from idea to delivery.

model.title: A specialist workshop for each product.
model.subtitle: Instead of one factory that does everything, we work with workshops chosen for their skill.
model.c1Text: Each product goes to a workshop that masters it and works from our technical file.
model.c2Text: You don't manage workshops or suppliers. MAKERS follows your project and answers your questions.
model.c3Text: Measurements, seams, logo and finishes are checked on the sample, then on your order.
model.c4Text: Your designs and logos stay yours. They are never reused or resold.

how.title: From sample to collection.
how.subtitle: You see and approve the product before production starts.
how.s1Text: Fill in one request: your products, your brand, your idea.
how.s2Text: MAKERS clarifies your needs on WhatsApp, then confirms the sample's price and lead time before making it.
how.s3Text: The specialist workshop makes the sample with your logo.
how.s4Text: You check the quality, then receive a quotation for your order.
how.s5Text: Once you agree, the workshop produces, MAKERS checks, and you receive your order.
how.a1: The sample's price and lead time depend on the product. We confirm them before making it.
how.a2: It depends on the product and the workshop, and is stated in the quotation.
how.a3: Yes. One request is enough, tick every product you are interested in.
how.q4: I don't have a logo yet. Is that a problem?
how.a4: No. Mention it in your request and we'll discuss it with you.
how.a5: At partner workshops in Algeria, selected for each product type.

cta.title: Ready to see your brand on a real garment?
cta.text: One request, with no production commitment. We reply on WhatsApp.

about.title: We help new Algerian brands go from idea to product.
about.p1: Launching a clothing brand means finding the right fabric, workshop, embroiderer, labels and packaging. For a creator or a company, that is a lot of people to deal with.
about.p2: MAKERS brings that journey into one point of contact. We prepare the technical files, work with specialist workshops and follow quality while you build your brand.
about.who2Text: To make clothing for your community.
about.who3Text: For staff clothing and uniforms in your image.
